Our Expertise in AR Development

<01>

Experts will create easy-to-use interfaces that feel natural. Users will enjoy interacting with your app due to the attractive and practical design our programmers create. FAQs on Hiring AR Developers

How do AR, VR, and mixed reality differ?

Virtual reality is a digital environment that doesn’t exist, and the system controls your presence there. In augmented reality, digital elements overlay real-world surroundings, so you see an extended version of reality. The mixed reality allows for the interaction of its components. An AR engineer specializes in creating augmented and mixed realities settings.

Do you offer assistance with AR developer technical interviews?

Absolutely, our services include targeted assistance for Augmented Reality (AR) developer technical interviews, available for an additional fee. We ensure these interviews are conducted by top professionals in AR, crucial for teams looking to innovate with AR technologies. A comprehensive analysis and insights from the interviewer will be provided, helping you assess the candidate’s expertise in AR development.

How do apps built by AR developers work?

AR application is the software for a tablet, a smartphone, headsets, or smart glasses. So, you’ll need a gadget with an installed AR app to explore augmented reality. Once you open the application, the device’s camera and sensors identify your position. Then, computer vision analyzes the video and imposes digital items on it. An AR app developer is responsible for the quality of 3D objects and interaction options.

What skills are essential for an augmented reality developer?

Your AR programmer should know AR development instruments like Apple ARKit, Google ARCore, Unity, etc. They should also be proficient in 3D modeling tools like 3ds Max, Maya, or Blender. Unreal Engine (UE) is essential for video game development. Coding in C++ and C# programming languages and knowledge of UX design are crucial.

How can I explore the proficiency of AR app developers?

First, check the applicant’s past AR projects and ask which tools and platforms they prefer and why. Also, during a tech interview, you can learn which principles and best practices your candidate follows. However, only a small project or a test task will let you see the code quality and approaches to programming.

How much will I pay to hire AR app developers?

In the US, you can hire AR developers for $84,000-$133,000 annually, while in Germany, a full-time AR programmer earns around $40,000 per year. A freelancer can get between $30 and $150 per hour. The remuneration depends on the experience and location of an AR expert. Also, project complexity will impact the payroll.

Will my augmented reality software engineer work on Android and iOS?

Many AR developers can create apps for both operating systems, but it’s not a “default configuration.” You can look through their knowledge from a resume’s skills section: The ARKit development pack is used for creating iOS apps, and ARCore is for Android. However, you can check proficiency level only during an interview.

Is knowing 3D design critical for an augmented reality app developer?

Experience in 3D design is valuable for AR coders. That’s because they overlay virtual 3D objects and environments over existing physical settings, and the result must look realistic. So, they should know how to create 3D models optimized for AR apps with Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, and similar tools.
